name: PoseTek: Soccer Training
subtitle: Test. Review. Train. Repeat.
promotionalText: Start with evidence. Explore six soccer performance tests, review your results, and follow a training plan with PoseTek.
description:
Start with evidence. Train what’s next.

PoseTek connects soccer performance testing, athlete results, and guided training. For players and coaches, it brings the next training decision closer to the evidence behind it.

TEST YOUR GAME
Record six performance tests: shooting, sprint, vertical jump, broad jump, dribbling, and change of direction. Follow each test’s setup to build your performance history.

REVIEW YOUR RESULTS
Explore drill results, revisit recorded reps, and use movement playback to look more closely at a session. Bring your results together in an athlete profile across speed, power, agility, ball control, and striking.

FIND YOUR FOCUS
Ask AI Coach about your results and training. Build a plan around your goals and availability, with explanations for the exercises included.

FOLLOW YOUR SESSION
Open a workout, review drill instructions, and work through sets and rest periods. Keep completed sessions connected to your training plan.

RETEST AND REVIEW
Repeat the tests and compare your recorded results over time. Use what you learn to choose your next training focus.

PoseTek. Start with evidence.
